en.alias_tip: Optional. Reuse a worklist filled in on an earlier run as extra name answers. Unresolved names are reported, never guessed.
en.audio_channels_tip: 2ch is half the size and plays everywhere. 4ch matches the shipped songs, which carry a rear mix; choose it only if the source has rear audio.
en.audio_quality_tip: Vorbis quality -q (0-10): higher is better and bigger. 6 is already transparent; the game only needs Vorbis at 44100 Hz.
en.audio_src_tip: Any ogg / wav / flac / mp3 of the song. The file chooser opens in the same folder with the same name, so only retype a name you want changed.
en.camera_vmd_tip: The MMD camera file to convert. Like the dance, it is 30 fps; the .a3da comes out at 60 fps, one source frame per two.
en.ch4_tip: The shape the shipped songs are in.
en.clear_first_tip: Clear the Import Rig's motion before loading this .vmd. Overwriting only replaces bones the new file animates, so untouched bones keep posing the previous song. Turn this on when switching songs.
en.decimals_tip: Decimal places used to decide whether a channel ever moves: values equal at this rounding are written once as a constant instead of a key per frame. Accepted files use 4; lower discards real micro-motion, higher only grows the file.
en.face_base_tip: Optional. A stock PV script to splice into: everything that is not a face cue - notes, stage cues, timings - is preserved record for record. Leave it EMPTY to generate a minimal scaffold instead: the face stream then runs on the motion's own clock with no borrowed camera, stage or lyric timeline to contradict it. The generated script carries the bootstrap block a shipping script opens with, PV_END after the last cue, and is validated before use. Camera work comes from the camera export, not from here.
en.face_chara_tip: The character number written as the first argument of every cue: 0 is this chart's first dancer, 1 the second. The wrong value puts the mouth motion on the wrong person, or on nobody.
en.face_code_tip: Whose slot table morph names are looked up in: MIK Miku, LEN Len, LUK Luka, RIN Rin, KAI Kai, NER Neru, HAK Meiko, SAK Teto, APO, WAN, GIR, MON. Match the chart's singer. With the wrong table most names resolve to nothing and drop into the worklist.
en.face_root: Mouth numbers read from the slot tables under: %s
en.motion_vmd_tip: The imported dance. Import motion records the file here, and Export expressions reads its morphs from here, so the two always work on the same song.
en.overwrite_tip: Off by default: an existing file is never touched; the export stops and names it. Turn on to replace.
en.scale_keys_tip: Ratio between sampled and recorded frame numbers. The template samples at 60 fps and the .vmd is 30 fps; the 2x is already applied in the scene's time base, so keep this at 1.0. Any other value re-times the whole dance.
en.face_pmx_tip: The dance's own MMD model. With it the export measures what every morph actually deforms - vertex offsets at weight 1, in interocular units - and can decide a mapping from the measured effect as well as the name. Without it nothing about the geometry is known, every decision is name- and table-based, and the report says 'geometry equivalence: NOT VERIFIED'. Left empty, a .pmx sitting beside the .vmd is used when exactly one is there.
en.face_audit_tip: Write a per-morph report next to the script: source morphology, measured effect, semantic category with its evidence, target, mapping method, grade, keyframe counts and the reason for anything that could not be transferred. Every morph the motion animates appears exactly once, so 'silent drops 0' is checked rather than claimed.
en.face_base: Base PV script (.dsc) - leave empty to generate one

zh_CN.alias_tip: 可留空。复用上次填好的待填清单作为额外答案。仍未命中的名字只报告，不会猜测。
zh_CN.audio_channels_tip: 2ch 体积减半、到处都能播放。4ch 与原装歌曲相同（带后声道混音），仅在源含后方音频时选择。
zh_CN.audio_quality_tip: Vorbis 品质 -q（0〜10，越高越好也越大）。这里 6 已足够透明；游戏只要求是 44100 Hz 的 Vorbis。
zh_CN.audio_src_tip: 歌曲的 ogg / wav / flac / mp3 均可。保存对话框会在同一目录以同名打开，只需修改真正想改的名字。
zh_CN.camera_vmd_tip: 要转换的 MMD 镜头 .vmd。和动作一样是 30fps，.a3da 按 2 倍写成 60fps。
zh_CN.ch4_tip: 与本体歌曲相同的形态。
zh_CN.clear_first_tip: 读入这个 .vmd 前先清空 Import Rig 上的原有动作。覆盖式导入只替换新文件涉及的骨骼，未碰到的骨会沿用上一首歌的姿势；换歌时请勾选。
zh_CN.decimals_tip: 判定某通道是否一直不动所用的精度。按此位数取整后相同的值只写一个常量，而非每帧一个键。已验收文件用的是 4：调太小会丢掉真实微动，调大只是白白变大。
zh_CN.face_base_tip: 可留空。填入原装 PV 脚本时，除表情流外的音符、舞台指令、时值都会逐条保留。留空则自动生成一个最小脚手架：表情流直接踩在动作自己的时间轴上，不会被借来的镜头、舞台、歌词时间轴干扰。生成的脚本包含官方脚本开头的引导块、最后一条 cue 之后的 PV_END，使用前经过校验。镜头内容来自镜头导出，不来自这里。
zh_CN.face_chara_tip: 写入每条指令第一个参数的角色序号：0 为本谱面一号角色，1 为二号。填错会让口型落在错的人身上，或无人开口。
zh_CN.face_code_tip: 按哪个角色的槽表查询 morph 名（MIK 初音、LEN 巡、LUK 镜、RIN 凛、KAI kaito、NER 鸣、HAK meiko、SAK 始音、APO、WAN、GIR、MON）。要和谱面角色一致；表不对会大量名字查不到，全落进待填清单。
zh_CN.face_root: 口型编号所用的槽表读取自：%s
zh_CN.motion_vmd_tip: 已导入的舞蹈文件。“导入动作”会把路径记在这里，“导出表情”也从这里读取，确保两者始终针对同一首歌。
zh_CN.overwrite_tip: 不勾选（默认）时绝不改动已有文件：导出会停止并报出文件名；勾选后才执行替换。
zh_CN.scale_keys_tip: 采样帧号与文件记录帧号的比例。模板按 60fps 采样、vmd 为 30fps，2 倍关系已作用在场景时间基上，请保持 1.0；填其他值会把整段舞蹈重新变速。
zh_CN.face_pmx_tip: 该舞蹈原本使用的 MMD 模型。提供后，导出会测量每个表情实际改变了什么（权重 1 时的顶点位移，以双眼间距为单位），从而可以同时依据实测效果与名称决定映射。不提供时几何信息完全未知，所有决定只能基于名称与查表，报告会标注「几何等价性：未验证」。留空时，若 .vmd 旁边恰好只有一个 .pmx，会自动使用它。
zh_CN.face_audit_tip: 在脚本旁写出逐表情报告：源形态、实测效果、语义类别及其证据、目标、映射方式、评级、关键帧数量，以及任何无法迁移项的原因。动画里出现的每个表情都会且只会出现一次，因此「静默丢弃 0」是被检查过的结论，而不是声明。
zh_CN.face_base: 作为基础的 PV 脚本（.dsc）—— 留空则自动生成
